## Added
- **Lonsdaleite on Minecraft 1.21.1** — the current feature set, backported to Fabric **and** NeoForge.
  - Two gear tiers (Lonsdaleite + Perfect Lonsdaleite): full tool set, armor, Dagger, War Axe, Mace, and the Omnitool with its right-click interactions (strip / scrape / till / path / douse).
  - **Lonsdaleite Wardframe** — a crystal doorway only players and their tamed pets may pass; adjacent frames merge into one gate of any size.
  - Same progression: Diamonds → Raw → Prepared → Lonsdaleite Gem (Blast Furnace), then Gem → Perfect Gem.

## Notes
- **Spears are not included** on this version — they rely on kinetic-weapon components that only exist in Minecraft 26.2.
